---
title: Validation & Benchmarks
---

Comparisons of NumCosmo against the Core Cosmology Library (CCL), validating
agreement on key observables, and against values certified in arbitrary
precision, which establish accuracy rather than agreement.

- [CCL Background](ccl_background.qmd) --- background expansion and distances.
- Halo mass function
  - [CCL Halo Mass Function](ccl_mass_function.qmd) --- halo mass function and
    multiplicity function for eight multiplicity-function families, at CCL's default
    and high-precision settings.
  - [CCL Halo Mass Function Precision](ccl_mass_function_precision.qmd) --- the
    parameters of CCL's tabulated mass variance, and the halo mass function with one
    group of them raised at a time.
  - [CCL Tinker Mass Functions](ccl_mass_function_tinker.qmd) --- halo mass function
    and multiplicity function for Tinker (2008) and Tinker (2010), at their mass
    definitions, at CCL's default and high-precision settings.
  - [CCL Despali Mass Function](ccl_mass_function_despali.qmd) --- halo mass function
    and multiplicity function for Despali (2016), with the ellipsoidal correction, at its
    mass definitions, at CCL's default and high-precision settings.
  - [CCL Bocquet Mass Function](ccl_mass_function_bocquet.qmd) --- halo mass function
    and multiplicity function for Bocquet (2016), in its hydrodynamical calibration, at
    its mass definitions, at CCL's default and high-precision settings.
  - [CCL Watson Mass Function](ccl_mass_function_watson.qmd) --- halo mass function
    and multiplicity function for Watson (2013), at its mass definitions, at CCL's
    default and high-precision settings.
- [CCL Power Spectrum](ccl_power_spectrum.qmd) --- linear and nonlinear matter power spectra.
- [CCL Two-Point Correlation](ccl_two_point.qmd) --- angular two-point statistics.
- [Certified Radial Projection](xcor_certified_projection.qmd) --- the radial
  integral $I_\ell(k)$ against Arb, including the redshift-space weight, with
  CCL's non-Limber method on the same certified values.
- [Angular Power Spectrum Derivatives](xcor_derivatives.qmd) --- the same
  clustering spectrum from UltraLevin and from CCL's FKEM, and its derivative
  with respect to $\Omega_c$ taken with `NcmDiff` on both: agreement on the
  spectrum does not carry over to the derivative.
- [Certified Shape Marginal](wl_shape_marginal.qmd) --- the weak-lensing shape
  marginal of the four `NcGalaxyShapeFactor` classes against Arb: where each
  fails, its cost, and the interpolants of a fixed population.
